UI_TW_AutoRack_tooltip: On: racks the bolt by itself after a reload into an empty chamber and after every shot of a pump or bolt action, even if another mod makes that manual. Off: you rack after a reload. Default: On.
UI_TW_CarryHelp: Hold the key for the stance menu: low ready, high ready or patrol carry, crouch or stand up.
UI_TW_DeviceHelp: Hold the devices key for the menu of the devices and their modes; hold R for the reload menu (top up the magazine, another magazine). Without a separate mode key, Shift + the devices key changes the mode. IR beams and IR illumination are visible only through night vision.
UI_TW_LaserIdle_tooltip: A switched-on laser shines whenever the weapon is in hands, lowered too. Off: only while aiming. Default: On.
UI_TW_LightEffects_tooltip: Visible beam in the dark, lens flare and light spot over the game light. Off: the game light only. Default: On.
UI_TW_LightFollowsWeapon_tooltip: With the weapon lowered the beam follows its barrel. Off: the light shines where the character looks. Default: On.
UI_TW_OpticEffects: Night vision and thermal scope image
UI_TW_OpticEffects_tooltip: Aiming through a night vision or thermal scope shows its image: night vision, or the thermal palette with warm bodies. Default: On.
UI_TW_ShotSmoke_tooltip: Muzzle gas, muzzle-device smoke and the barrel smoke trail after a burst. Other shot effects have separate options. Default: On.
UI_TW_BarrelHeat_tooltip: Barrel and suppressor glow, including their heat in thermal sights. Off: skips weapon heat calculations and drawing. Default: On.
UI_TW_ShotFlash_tooltip: Flashes and glowing particles at the muzzle. Smoke, sparks and shot lighting have separate options. Default: On.
UI_TW_ShotSparks_tooltip: Sparks and streaks emitted by shots. Off: skips their creation and drawing. Default: On.
UI_TW_ShotLight_tooltip: Brief light from shots and launcher back-blast. Flashlights and explosion lights keep their own settings. Default: On.
UI_TW_ImpactParticles_tooltip: Dust, smoke, sparks and debris at bullet impacts. Off: removes existing particles and skips new ones. Impact sounds remain. Default: On.
UI_TW_ImpactDecals_tooltip: Surface marks left by bullet impacts. Off: removes existing marks and skips new ones. Damage and impact sounds remain. Default: On.
UI_TW_ReturnMainWeapon: Switch back to the main weapon before editing its assembly.
UI_TW_ViewpointGiveToStt: Let Shoot to Thrill handle this mod's weapons
UI_TW_ViewpointGiveToStt_tooltip: With Viewpoint support on, Shoot to Thrill may handle this mod's weapons. Off: they are excluded from it. Default: Off.
UI_TW_ViewpointSupport_tooltip: Use this mod's Viewpoint features while Viewpoint is active. Off: also removes the Shoot to Thrill exclusions this mod set. Default: On.
UI_TW_SightZoomHelp: While aiming through an adjustable sight, hold the modifier and use the wheel. Left Alt also remains bound to sprint, floor attack and voice in the game; rebind this modifier if needed. The sight key and menus select channels; the optic-mode key changes illumination or image mode.
UI_TW_ReticleBrightness_tooltip: With a sight of this mod in hands, hold these modifiers and turn the wheel: up brighter, down dimmer; saved per sight. To rebind, open the row, hold other modifiers and turn the wheel.
UI_TW_WeaponObstacleIsometric_tooltip: Walls and obstacles block the weapon in the isometric view too; the Viewpoint views always use it. Default: Off.
UI_TW_SightZeroHelp: With a weapon from this mod equipped, Page Up / Page Down select the next / previous calibration distance of its active sight. The distance stays with that sight. Rebind these keys if they conflict with your controls.
UI_TW_ScopePip_tooltip: Draws the world inside the lens of optical scopes in first person, 1x optics too. Needs Viewpoint; applies at once. Default: On.
UI_TW_ScopePipResolution: Scope picture resolution (share of the shorter screen side)
UI_TW_ScopePipResolutionHelp: Resolution 0.5 is the default. The picture is never drawn larger than the eyepiece on the screen.
UI_TW_ViewpointSensorHead_tooltip: With night vision goggles on in Viewpoint, the view gets the colour, grain and eyepiece outline of the device. Default: On.
UI_TW_ViewpointSensorDevice_tooltip: Which device the goggles look like. Automatic: by the name of the worn goggles. Default: Automatic.
UI_TW_ViewpointSensorHeat_tooltip: Resolution of the heat image of bodies, vehicles and fires. Lower is faster but can miss small distant heat. Applies at once. Default: Half.
UI_TW_ViewpointBallistics_tooltip: On: this mod's bullets fly with their own ballistics and hit in single player. Shadow: flights are only logged. Off: the installed shooting system. In multiplayer the server's sandbox option decides for everyone. Default: On (live damage).
UI_TW_AdsCamera: Narrow the field of view while aiming
UI_TW_AdsCamera_tooltip: Smoothly narrows the first-person view while aiming, by the sight in use: iron sight, collimator or scope. Default: On.
UI_TW_AdsHideCrosshair_tooltip: Hides the dot and aim ring of Viewpoint while aiming down the sights of this mod's weapons. Default: On.
UI_TW_FpRecoil: Recoil, weapon sway and arm stamina
UI_TW_FpRecoil_tooltip: Weapon and camera recoil, sway, breathing, arm stamina and aim time of this mod's weapons in Viewpoint first person. Default: On.
UI_TW_HoldBreathHelp: Hold the breath key while aiming down sights to steady the weapon in Viewpoint's first-person view; holding uses up the breath, tired arms shake the weapon more.
UI_TW_HipFire_tooltip: In Viewpoint first person the attack button without aiming fires from the ready pose, along the barrel; from a carry stance the weapon is raised first. Default: On.
UI_TW_ViewpointPerf_tooltip: Writes CPU and GPU timings to the log once per second; this costs performance. Applies at once. Default: Off.
UI_TW_ScopePipFrequency_tooltip: Slower refresh is faster to draw; moving the sight or changing its zoom refreshes it at once. Moving targets may step while the sight is still. Default: Every frame.
UI_TW_StanceMouse: Side mouse button: last carry stance
UI_TW_StanceMouse_tooltip: In Viewpoint first person a press enters the last carry stance, the next press leaves it. If the button is Viewpoint's free-look key, it stays with free look. Default: Mouse 5.
UI_TW_StanceLeave_tooltip: In Viewpoint first person: raise the weapon from the carry stance to the ready pose. Not bound by default.
UI_TW_StanceEnter: Key: enter the last carry stance
UI_TW_StanceEnter_tooltip: In Viewpoint first person: lower the weapon into the last carry stance. Not bound by default.
UI_TW_ThirdPersonStances: Mod stances in third person (low ready, high ready, patrol)
UI_TW_ThirdPersonStances_tooltip: Off: in third person this mod's weapons keep a plain pose, so other animation mods (Tactical Hold and the like) apply; the mod's stances stay in first person. Default: On.
UI_TW_ArmStaminaBar_tooltip: Arm stamina near the hotbar, hidden when full; it recovers while you do not aim. Default: On.
UI_TW_AnimVanillaThird_tooltip: On: in isometric and third person the mod stops posing every character this game draws, so vanilla and other mods' animations show; firing and reloading work. Applies at once. Default: Off.
UI_TW_AnimVanillaFirst_tooltip: On: first person keeps vanilla animations outside aim. Sight alignment, firing and reloading work; the mod's recoil and hip fire stay off. Applies at once. Default: Off.
UI_TW_WeaponUtilityHelp: Inspect: semicolon; check chamber: apostrophe; check magazine: comma; fire mode: backslash. The original B, L and T keys are occupied in Project Zomboid. Bind each action here.
UI_TW_PanicSway: Weapon sway from stress and panic
UI_TW_PanicSway_tooltip: Stress and panic make the hands and the weapon float a little; the bullet still goes where the sight points. Default: On.
UI_TW_OptionsKeyCombos: Keys work with a weapon of this mod in hands. To bind a combination, hold Shift, Ctrl or Alt while the screen waits for the key.
UI_TW_ToggleDevice_tooltip: A press switches the weapon's lights and lasers on or off. Holding opens the menu of the devices and their modes.
UI_TW_CycleDeviceMode_tooltip: Next mode of a light or laser. Not bound: Shift + the devices key.
UI_TW_SightMenu_tooltip: Choose the active sight and the mode of a night vision or thermal scope.
UI_TW_CycleOpticMode_tooltip: Reticle illumination, or the image mode of a night vision or thermal scope. Not bound: Ctrl + the devices key.
UI_TW_SightZoomModifier_tooltip: While aiming through an adjustable scope, hold the key and turn the mouse wheel.
UI_TW_SightZero_tooltip: Next or previous zeroing distance of the active sight. The distance stays with that sight.
UI_TW_FireModeSwitch_tooltip: Single, burst or auto for the weapon in hands. Not bound by default: the Gunworks fire mode key (T) switches it too.
UI_TW_ReadyToggle_tooltip: Press: next carry stance (low ready, high ready, patrol). Hold: stance menu, crouch or stand up. In multiplayer the game's safety toggle uses the same key; rebind if needed.
UI_TW_HoldBreath_tooltip: Hold while aiming to steady the weapon in Viewpoint first person. It uses up breath; tired arms shake more.
UI_TW_AdsNarrowIron: Narrowing for iron sights and collimators
UI_TW_AdsNarrowHelp: Narrowing in percent: 0 keeps your view, 100 is the strongest. Default: 30 for iron sights and collimators, 25 for scopes.
UI_TW_SeeThroughWeapon: See-through, blurred model: weapon, sight and hands
UI_TW_SeeThroughWeapon_tooltip: While aiming and in high ready the weapon, sight and hands become see-through and blurred, as the eye sees them; the reticle and front sight stay solid. Best with TAA in Viewpoint. Default: Off.
UI_TW_SeeThroughHelp: Opacity in percent (default 50) and blur in pixels of a 1080-line image (default 5) apply at full aim and in high ready.
UI_TW_JavaTitle: Escape From Zomboid Firearms: the Java part is not loaded
UI_TW_ShowWarnings_tooltip: Show notices when Java is missing or mod files have different versions. Hiding them keeps console diagnostics and compatibility checks active. Default: On.
UI_TW_WarningsHint: Hide these notices: Options > Mods > EFZ: Compatibility > Show Java and version warnings.
UI_TW_JavaBlocked: ZombieBuddy did not load this mod's Java part: it was denied or not approved when the game started. ZombieBuddy asks again after every update of the mod.
UI_TW_JavaMissing: ZombieBuddy is not running, and this mod's Java part needs it.
UI_TW_JavaLost: Without it the mod works only in part: no aiming down sights and no first-person weapon poses with Viewpoint, no scope pictures, no thermal and night vision scopes, no support hand on the handguard and no moving bolts, none of the mod's muzzle flash, smoke and heat effects. Lasers and flashlights run slower and are not drawn correctly in Viewpoint's first person.
UI_TW_JavaAllow: To allow it: quit the game, start it again and hold Shift while it loads. In ZombieBuddy's window allow EscapeFromZomboidFirearms. Or, with the game closed, delete the EscapeFromZomboidFirearms entry with "decision": false from .zombie_buddy/mod_approvals.json in your user folder.
UI_TW_JavaEnable: To fix it: subscribe to ZombieBuddy, enable it in the mod list and restart the game.
UI_TW_AdsFromThird: Third person: click to aim down the sight, hold to aim
UI_TW_AdsFromThird_tooltip: In Viewpoint third person a quick right click aims through the sight as in first person; a hold aims from third person as before. A quick click no longer opens the object menu. Default: On.
UI_TW_IsometricBallistics_tooltip: The mod's ballistics, penetration and body-zone damage in the isometric view too. In multiplayer the server decides. Default: Off.
UI_TW_VerTitle: Escape From Zomboid Firearms: the mod's files are from different versions
UI_TW_VerKindFileChanged: a file is not the one the manifest describes:
UI_TW_VerKindFileMissing: a file of the mod is missing:
UI_TW_VerKindManifestMissing: the version manifest is missing, so the files did not update completely
UI_TW_VerKindManifestUnreadable: the version manifest on disk cannot be read
UI_TW_VerKindManifestStale: the files on disk changed while the game was running
UI_TW_VerKindManifestFormat: the version manifest has an unknown format
UI_TW_VerKindJavaMissing: the Java part is not loaded: enable ZombieBuddy and allow the mod
UI_TW_VerKindJavaMismatch: the Java part is another version
UI_TW_VerKindCopyNewer: the Steam Workshop copy is newer
UI_TW_VerAction: Restart the game. If this stays: in Steam unsubscribe from the mod and subscribe again, then remove an older copy of it from Zomboid\mods.
UI_TW_OptionsAudioHelp: Volume of the mod's sounds in percent: 0 silent, 100 normal (default), 200 double. Only what you hear changes, not what other players or zombies hear.
UI_TW_HostTitle: Escape From Zomboid Firearms: server mods
UI_TW_HostNoWorkshopId: These mods of the server have no Steam Workshop item: %1. The server finds them only in Zomboid/mods or Zomboid/Workshop on this computer, and other players cannot download them.
UI_TW_HostNoServerModule: The server has %1 without its server module %2. Add %2 to the server's mods: the server needs it for server ballistics and for smoke grenades that block zombie sight.
UI_TW_ServerModsTitle: Escape From Zomboid Firearms is not on this server
UI_TW_ServerModsText: The server's mod list has no %1, so its weapons, loot and settings are off in this game. Only the Java part was loaded when the game started, and it does nothing here.
UI_TW_ServerModsHost: Hosting from the main menu (HOST - Manage settings - Edit Selected Settings): page "Steam Workshop" needs %1, page "Mods" needs %2. With Escape From Zomboid Firearms enabled in the main menu, NEXT, SAVE and START fill the Steam Workshop page. Then start the server again.
UI_TW_ServerModsDedicated: Dedicated server: WorkshopItems=%1 and Mods=%2 in its server settings file.
UI_TW_MouseSensitivity_tooltip: How fast the first-person view turns while the weapon is not aimed, on top of the sensitivity of Viewpoint. Default: 1.
UI_TW_AimingSensitivity_tooltip: Multiplier while aiming: 1 keeps the sight's own value, 0.5 is half the speed, 2 double. Default: 1.
UI_TW_SightSensitivityByZoom_tooltip: On: the view turns slower through magnifying sights, by each sight's own value. Off: one aiming speed for every sight. Default: On.
UI_TW_SensitivityHelp: 1 is the normal speed (default). Mouse sensitivity works at the hip, aiming sensitivity while aiming; both multiply the mouse speed of Viewpoint.
UI_TW_ServerJavaTitle: Escape From Zomboid Firearms: this server runs without the mod's Java part
UI_TW_ServerJavaWhy: Server ballistics and frag-grenade fragments still work: the shooters' clients fly them and the server checks them. Without the Java part:
UI_TW_HostJavaWhy: A server started with Host cannot run the mod's Java part (ZombieBuddy does not reach it; a dedicated server with ZombieBuddy has it). Without it:
UI_TW_ServerJavaSmoke: - Smoke grenades hide you from zombies less reliably.
UI_TW_ServerJavaHint: Full log: console.txt. Hide: Mods > EFZ: Compatibility.
UI_TW_ScopePicture_tooltip: For magnifying, variable, night vision and thermal scopes. Picture in the eyepiece: the world is drawn again inside the lens. Zoom: no second render. By magnification: the scope stays in front of the eye. Eye to the eyepiece: the eyepiece fills the screen, every mark matches. Default: Picture in the eyepiece.
UI_TW_OptionsRecoilHelp: Sway strength: 1 is normal (default), 0 none, 2 double.
UI_TW_GamepadHelp: Buttons and two-button chords. Keyboard and mouse bindings stay separate.
UI_TW_GamepadBind_tooltip: Select, then press a button or hold one and press another.
UI_TW_GamepadCapture: Press a button, or hold one and press another
